notes.title: Update - Changelogs 1.1.1
notes.content:

Some of them are graphical ones, like improved trees, other of them are new settings, such as "Inver Y Axis".

Marco

notes.title: Update - Changelogs 1.1.0
notes.content:
Hi.

This is the first big update of the game.

Tons of things has been fixed.

[b] Here's the most important changes:[/b]

[list]
[*]Added the possibility to remove ammo and attachments from weapons.
[*]Map updated: New locations and models
[*]New grass.
[*]Visual quality improvements.
[*]Big performance optimization.
[*]Several other fixes.
[/list]

tags.feature: [*]Added the possibility to remove ammo and attachments from weapons.
